> **Charles' Clean up, weekly schedule**
>
> **I. Preface:**
>
> **A.**
>
> Memorize and apply the golden housekeeping rules: By following these rules you will save 50% of your time in taking care of your house. All of the following chores are to be done before going to bed. No bleeding heart, glazed eyes excuses that "I am tired", "I don't feel like it", "it doesn't really matter", "I will do it tomorrow". We are looking for preventative cleaning rather than crisis cleaning. God is a planner, a God of order and evolution isn't true. Your house will not go from chaos to order unless there is some planning and effort to keep it cleaned and organized.
>
> Everything has it's place.
>
> Do it now.
>
> **B.**
>
> Before implementing this schedule you must do an initial cleaning to the standard that you desire. This includes having everything in your house having a place, your garage organized and things placed where you want, things thrown out that you don't intend to keep, floors, shelves cleaned, car cleaned out. This may be done by doing a little every day, or some every day, and taking the weekend to finish. The goal is to get you house, garage, and car the way you want to keep it all the time within a weeks time.
>
> NOTE: Feel free to switch some of the chores to another day if that works out better for your schedule, BUT everything on the list has to be done by Sunday evening, or Monday evening if you have weekend warrior.
>
> **C. Note:**
>
> 1. There are a lot of items that need to be taken out of the house, bedroom, kitchen and put into the garage, ie: table that is behind couch, some kitchen things on refrig that you don't use often.
>
> 2. Light bulb needs replaced in bathroom.
>
> 3. Need to find a place in your office for mail, refer back to earlier papers on mail.
>
> 4. There are items in garage that need to be thrown out, given away, or find a place to be stored.
>
> 5. The car is to be cleaned out every night when coming home. Only items that belong there, or are going to be used the next day can be left.
>
> 6. The entry way to the house should be vacuumed when sweeping or vacuuming the house. The stairs should be swept or vacuumed as well.
>
> 7. The dining room table, coffee tables are not for storage.
>
> 8. Get screen for your bathroom window.
>
> **II. Schedule**
>
> **Monday:**
>
> Sweep/ mop/ vacuum all floors, carpets, dust all areas needing it, including blinds, any house mirrors, includes stairs and entry platform.
>
> Clear out kitchen sink/ counters, wipe down and clear counters, and kitchen table.
>
> Note: There should never be anything in the sink unless you are washing the dishes in the sink after using. It takes the same amount of energy to put it in the dishwasher as it does the sink. Same applies to counters.
>
> Before going to bed, pick up and put away any items that are not where they should be.
>
> Check car for anything left in it. (preferably do this when coming home from work)
>
> Make sure book/novelty shelves are clean, neat, and no junk there that doesn't belong there.
>
> Note: Do not leave anything laying around the house that you do not intend to use, everything has it's place.
>
> **Tuesday:**
>
> Clear out kitchen sink/ counters, wipe down and clear counters, kitchen table, before going to bed.
>
> Before going to bed, pick up and put away any items that are not where they should be.
>
> Do laundry and dry. Fold and put away clothes, hang shirts and pants.
>
> Check car for anything left in it. (preferably do this when coming home from work)
>
> Make sure bar is clean, dust, put away things that don't belong there.
>
> Note: Do not leave anything laying around the house that you do not intend to use, everything has it's place.
>
> **Wednesday:**
>
> Clear out kitchen sink/ counters, wipe down and clear counters, kitchen table before going to bed.
>
> Before going to bed, pick up and put away any items that are not where they should be.
>
> Note: Do not leave anything laying around the house that you do not intend to use, everything has it's place.
>
> Check windows to see if they need cleaning, as well as deck, and stairs going up to your condo. Clean if needed.
>
> Check car for anything left in it. (preferably do this when coming home from work)
>
> Clean up bedroom, floors, desk, bathroom, mirror, toilet, sink, tub, etc.
>
> **Thursday:**
>
> Clear out kitchen sink/ counters, wipe down and clear counters, kitchen table before going to bed.
>
> Before going to bed, pick up and put away any items that are not where they should be.
>
> Note: Do not leave anything laying around the house that you do not intend to use, everything has it's place.
>
> Kitchen: Clean all appliances, cupboards, clean out old food in Refrig. clean shelves
>
> Check car for anything left in it. (preferably do this when coming home from work)
>
> Clean out laundry room if needed.
>
> Check hall closets to make sure everything is where it should be.
>
> **Friday:**
>
> Clear out kitchen sink/ counters, wipe down and clear counters, kitchen table, before going to bed.
>
> Before going to bed, pick up and put away any items that are not where they should be.
>
> Check car for anything left in it. (preferably do this when coming home from work)
>
> Note: Do not leave anything laying around the house that you do not intend to use, everything has it's place.
>
> **Saturday:** (if gone for weekend Sat and Sun jobs go to Monday)
>
> Clear out kitchen sink/ counters, wipe down and clear counters, kitchen table before going to bed.
>
> Turn on dishwasher and make sure after dried to put dishes away.
>
> Clean other bathroom, sink, toilet, floor, mirror, bath tub, door nobs and toilet handle. Replace lights as needed.
>
> Garage, sweep floor and put away anything out of place. Clean out car and trunk.
>
> Wash car if needs it, vacuum out, dust and clean windows, trunk.
>
> Before going to bed, pick up and put away any items that are not where they should be this includes bedroom.
>
> Check car for anything left in it. (preferably do this when coming home )
>
> Note: Do not leave anything laying around the house that you do not intend to use, everything has it's place.
>
> **Sunday:**
>
> Clear out kitchen sink/ counters, wipe down and clear counters, kitchen table before going to bed.
>
> Before going to bed, pick up and put away any items that are not where they should be, this includes bedroom.
>
> Check car for anything left in it. (preferably do this when coming home)
>
> Note: Do not leave anything laying around the house that you do not intend to use, everything has it's place.
